title: God Level
notes: NEW: above 1 trillion Power the top bar switches to GOD LEVEL 神. It grows slowly (every x10 Power = +10 levels), recommended values switch too.
Recommended Power is now measured from real wins: S+ arena was 3x too high, S/S+ gates almost 2x, Master League up to 100x. Now it matches.
Master Gate is the endgame farm: loot at your hero level with better rarity, monsters around your gear level, every floor beatable.
Set pieces more than 30 levels below you no longer count for the set bonus, so old gear finally gets replaced (the item window warns you).
Master League re-tuned for the stronger gear: about 1 hour at x3 speed, about 3 hours to Master 99 in total.
Removed the 'Talents moved to their own tab' boxes.
